home.title: FlatShare
home.subtitle: Sample listings — rent is stored in PLN and converted for display.
home.heroTitle: Share a flat. Share a life.
home.heroSubtitle: FlatShare connects tenants and landlords with verified, modern listings across Poland — fast, transparent, and built for the way people really live together.
home.featuredLead: A glimpse of what's currently being listed — prices are stored in PLN and shown in your chosen currency.
home.featureVerifiedDesc: Every offer is reviewed by our team before going live — no spam, no surprises.
home.featureMatchingDesc: Tell us what you need — pets, smoking, districts, budget — and only see places that fit.
home.featureBilingualDesc: Built for Polish and international tenants. Switch language and currency in one click.
